sentence: This project builds tools that use health care data and machine learning to identify early and prevent chronic obstructive pulmonary disease progression.
This project develops a technique to control the degradation of decellularized plant scaffolds using ultrasound and microbubbles.
This project focuses on developing biomarkers and therapies for patients with aggressive prostate cancer.
This project tries to build a non-invasive approach that uses DNA methylation to improve detection and surveillance of glioma.
This project investigates methods to improve electrical integration between engineered cardiac tissue and the host heart.
This project studies anti-citrullinated protein antibodies in the female reproductive tract to understand rheumatoid arthritis.
This project uses CRISPR tools to correct mutations in three genes that cause inherited hearing loss in human inner ear cells and animal models.
This project develops computational strategies that use spatial statistics and deep learning to analyze detailed images of tumor microenvironments.
This project uses protein engineering to design treatments meant to stop atrial fibrillation and restore normal sinus rhythm.
This project studies the role of Gardnerella and Prevotella species as early colonizers in the development of bacterial vaginosis.
This project develops statistical methods using synthetic data from generative AI models to analyze whole genome sequencing studies and biobanks.
This project tries to find out how lipids are exchanged between mammals and their beneficial gut microbes.
This project studies how obesity treatments are used in the population and tests a tool to help clinicians and patients select them.
This project extends a computer model that simulates the clinical benefits and cost-effectiveness of genomic sequencing for newborns through adulthood.
This project studies how obesity changes the mechanical properties of breast adipose tissue and how that affects breast cancer invasion and metastasis.
This project tests which innate immune factors control infection by an endemic human coronavirus and compares their activity against a more lethal coronavirus.
This project builds tools that curate and manage data for cancer research, using statistical methods, artificial intelligence and machine learning.
This project studies how long-lasting sleep disruption affects thinking and memory recovery after traumatic brain injury, using a large animal model.
This project tries to find out how the coronavirus that causes COVID-19 replicates in the gastrointestinal tract and drives diarrheal disease.
This project studies risk factors at each step of lung cancer development to understand what drives its progression and to find biomarkers for early detection.
